critical_blocking_issues.root_cause: 3 endpoints críticos para captura de datos 3D (holografía y fotogrametría) NO ESTÁN IMPLEMENTADOS en api/routers/greenhouse.py. Los tests esperan endpoints que retornen 200 pero reciben 404 Not Found.
critical_blocking_issues.blocking_what: Captura de datos 3D en prototipos P1 y P2 para digital twin. Sin estos endpoints, no se puede registrar datos de holografía/fotogrametría ni consultar estado de digital twin.

test_expectations: POST /api/v1/greenhouse/{prototype_id}/holography/register — Retorna 200 con estructura {prototype_id, registered, capture{...}}
POST /api/v1/greenhouse/{prototype_id}/photogrammetry/register — Retorna 200 con estructura {prototype_id, registered, capture{...}}
GET /api/v1/greenhouse/{prototype_id}/digital-twin/status — Retorna 200 con {prototype_id, holography{captures_total}, photogrammetry{captures_total}, system_ready}
detailed_analysis.current_implementation: Router greenhouse.py tiene 9 endpoints (telemetry, status, alerts, actuator, recipe, history, compare, health, cloud_flush) pero FALTAN los 3 nuevos para captura 3D.
detailed_analysis.why_falta: Feature para digital twin (captura 3D de estado físico de prototipos) fue diseñada en tests pero no completó implementación en router. Tests fueron escritos como especificación adelantada.

contextual_analysis.root_cause_of_gap: Feature for digital twin 3D capture (holography + photogrammetry) was spec'd in tests AHEAD of implementation. Tests written as behavioral spec, but routes were not completed. This is a normal 'specification-first testing' approach that is now blocking integration.
contextual_analysis.why_this_happened:
Likely workflow:
  1. Test-driven development: tests written first to spec the exact API contract
  2. Router started with basic telemetry/status endpoints
  3. Advanced 3D capture feature scope expansion happened
  4. new tests written for 3D features
  5. router implementation was interrupted before completing the 3D endpoints
  6. Tests now fail because contract is defined but implementation missing
contextual_analysis.adoption_pattern: This is GOOD from a quality perspective — tests caught the missing feature before production deployment. This is exactly what TDD should do.
